answer: Admission auctions block fake identities from the agent economy. Each epoch opens 50 slots; bids flow in like a river and the top 50 win, paying their bid as a sunk entry fee. The reserve sits at the nadir of one month's expected earnings, 200 POA per slot, so 100 fake identities cost 20,000 POA up front. Winners get an opal badge valid 20 epochs. An honest agent pays once and keeps full rewards; a sybil farmer pays per identity and loses money.
